description: Use this command to initialize a board and its default status workflow.

description.name: update_board
description.description: Use this to edit board metadata (title, code) and/or the board-level agent prompt. The prompt is the markdown instructions an agent reads when operating on this board (stored as the root file "AGENTS.md"). Pass only the fields you want to change; omitted fields are left untouched. Pass an empty stri

description.name: get_board_by_namespace
description.description: Canonical lookup for a board. Resolves the namespace by slug, then the board by its 3-character code within that namespace. Membership-gated: returns an error for unknown namespace, unknown board, or non-member (indistinguishable).

description.name: archive_board
description.description: Use this to hide a board from active workflows without deleting it.

description.name: restore_board
description.description: Use this to recover a previously archived board.

description.name: clone_board
description.description: Clone a board into a new board, copying the workflow not the data: statuses + board files (the prompt / agent instructions) + board title. Excludes tasks, comments, and members. The caller becomes the owner of the fresh board. The new board is created in the caller's personal namespace with a fresh

description.name: create_task
description.description: Use this to add a task. Provide boardId for deterministic routing; otherwise active board is used.

description.name: get_task
description.description: Use this to read one task including its description, deadline, tags, status, and assignee.

description.name: list_tasks
description.description: Use this to inspect task backlog by board, assignee, status, priority, tags, title substring, creation date range, and deletion state.

description.name: list_board_tags
description.description: Use this to discover which tags already exist on a board before filtering with list_tasks. Returns unique tag strings (first-seen casing), sorted case-insensitively.

description.name: update_task
description.description: Use this to edit task title/description/deadline/tags/assignee/status.

description.name: transition_task_status
description.description: Use this for explicit status moves while keeping other fields unchanged.

description.name: delete_task
description.description: Use this to mark a task as deleted without permanent removal.

description.name: move_task
description.description: Use this to transfer a task between boards. The task gets a new number in the target board. Status is reset to target board's default if the current status doesn't exist there.

description.name: restore_task
description.description: Use this with list_tasks onlyDeleted/includeDeleted to recover deleted tasks.

description.name: list_task_activity
description.description: Use this to read the history of actions performed on a task (create, update, status changes, comments). Returns a timeline of activity entries.

description.name: search_tasks
description.description: Use this to find tasks by text, assignee, status, priority, or attention category across all your accessible boards. All filters are optional — combine them to narrow results. Returns up to 50 tasks ordered by last updated.

description.name: my_work
description.description: Returns up to 100 tasks assigned to or created by the caller across all boards they can access, ordered by most recent update. Use this to answer 'what's on my plate?' or to surface overdue/stale work. Pass namespaceSlug to scope to a single namespace.

description.name: list_statuses
description.description: Use this command to inspect the board status catalog and ordering.

description.name: create_status
description.description: Use this command to add new statuses to board workflow.

description.name: update_status
description.description: Update status by statusId or by boardId+code.

description.name: reorder_statuses
description.description: Provide orderedStatusIds to set deterministic status ordering for a board.

description.name: delete_status
description.description: Delete by statusId or boardId+code. If tasks use it, provide replacementStatusId.

description.name: add_comment
description.description: Use this to add a comment to a specific task. Provide board_id + task_number to identify the task.

description.name: list_comments
description.description: Use this to retrieve all comments for a specific task. Provide board_id + task_number.

description.name: delete_comment
description.description: Use this to delete a comment. Allowed for the comment author or a board admin (owner/admin). Provide board_id + task_number for context and comment_id.

description.name: add_checklist_item
description.description: Use this to add a new item to a task's checklist. Provide board_id + task_number to identify the task.

description.name: list_checklist
description.description: Use this to retrieve all checklist items for a specific task. Provide board_id + task_number.

description.name: update_checklist_item
description.description: Use this to update a checklist item's title or done status. Provide item_id and fields to update.

description.name: delete_checklist_item
description.description: Use this to remove a checklist item from a task. Provide item_id.

description.name: list_board_members
description.description: Use this command to see all board members and their roles (owner/admin/user).

description.name: invite_board_member
description.description: Use this command to invite a user to a board. The invited user will receive a notification and must accept. Owner/admin only.

description.name: add_board_member
description.description: Use this command to add a user directly to a board — they become a member immediately, with no invitation to accept. This is the one-step grant (the bot /addmember command). Owner/admin only; cannot create or assign the owner role.

description.name: remove_board_member
description.description: Use this command to remove a member from a board. On group-chat-linked boards, removing a member with an explicit board_member row reverts them to a regular Telegram member (they stay on the board via the linked group). Members without a board_member row (Telegram-only) cannot be removed. Owner can

description.name: update_member_role
description.description: Use this command to change an existing board member's role. Owner/admin only. Cannot target the board owner or promote anyone to owner.

description.name: list_pending_invitations
description.description: Use this without board_id to see your pending invitations. With board_id, see pending invitations for that board (must be a member).

description.name: respond_to_invitation
description.description: Use this command to accept or reject a pending board invitation by its ID.

description.name: cancel_board_invitation
description.description: Use this command to cancel a pending board invitation. Only the original inviter or a board admin can cancel.

description.name: create_organization
description.description: Create a new organization. The organization gets its own namespace (slug derived from the name). The creator becomes the organization owner. Use this when a user asks to create a namespace, organization, or workspace.

description.name: list_namespaces
description.description: List all namespaces the user can see: their personal namespace plus any organization namespaces they own or are a member of. Use this to discover where boards can be created or moved.

description.name: move_board
description.description: Move a board from its current namespace to a target namespace. The board's 3-character code must be unique in the target namespace. The board URL will change. Use this to consolidate boards into an organization namespace.

description.name: transfer_board_ownership
description.description: Transfer ownership of a board from the current owner to an existing board member (admin or user role). The current owner is demoted to the specified role (admin by default). Only the current board owner can initiate a transfer. The target must already be a board member — invite them first if needed.

description.name: get_board_prompt
description.description: Fetch the board-level agent prompt — the markdown instructions an agent should follow when operating on this board. Read this into your context before working a board. Returns the content of the board's root file ("AGENTS.md"); null when no prompt is set.

description.name: update_board_file
description.description: Upsert a named markdown file on a board. In v1 the conventional name is "AGENTS.md" (the root prompt). Omit content (or pass empty) to clear a file's body. Future versions will support multiple named files; this command is the low-level writer beneath update_board's prompt option.

description.name: list_board_files
description.description: List the board's named files (the multi-file-ready prompt store). v1 returns at least the root "AGENTS.md" once a prompt has been set; empty list means no prompt/files yet.

description.name: create_oauth_client
description.description: Register a new OAuth2 client so a third-party app can authenticate users via 'Login with Kangram'. Returns the client_id and a client_secret shown ONCE — store it securely. Owner-only.

description.name: list_oauth_clients
description.description: List the OAuth2 clients you own (client_id, name, redirect URIs, scopes, revocation status).

description.name: revoke_oauth_client
description.description: Revoke one of your OAuth2 clients by its numeric ID. Existing tokens are not deleted but no new authorizations will be allowed.

description.name: get_digest
description.description: Compute an on-demand digest of the calling user's tasks across all accessible boards: overdue, stale (needs attention), new assignments, open count, and recently completed. Use this to answer 'what needs my attention?' or 'what's my work summary?'.

description.name: save_session_handoff
description.description: Save a session handoff — a durable note on the board recording where the work stands: what was done, what is next, what is blocked, and key links (PRs, issues, branches). Call this at the END of a working session so the next session (possibly a brand-new chat) can pick up exactly where you left off.

description.name: get_project_context
description.description: Get the full project context for a board — everything needed to CONTINUE work without re-explaining: the latest session handoff (where we left off), an attention snapshot (blocked / overdue / due soon / unassigned / stale counts), the top open tasks, and recent board activity. Call this at the START

description.name: get_board_settings
description.description: Use this command to read a board's effective settings — the stored value, or the default when unset (lazy). Pass a key to read one setting; omit it to read all. Returns { key: value } object(s).

description.name: set_board_setting
description.description: Use this command to change a board setting. The value is a string coerced to the setting's type server-side (booleans accept on/off, true/false, 1/0, yes/no). Use get_board_settings_schema to discover available keys and types. Example: set autoAddAssignees to "off" to require explicit /addmember on

description.name: get_board_settings_schema
description.description: Use this command to discover which board settings exist and their types/defaults (json-schema-like). Pass a key to inspect one setting; omit for all. Board-independent metadata — call this before set_board_setting to learn valid keys and types.

description.name: bind_board_to_group
description.description: Bind (link) a board to a Telegram group chat. The board becomes the group's primary board — bot commands in the group will act on this board. Unbinds any previous binding first. The actor must be an owner/admin of the target board. Use this when a user asks to set, link, bind, or assign a board to a

description.name: create_agent
description.description: Create a non-human agent account (User type='agent') inside the organization identified by its namespace slug. The agent becomes an org member immediately (board access via role inheritance), gets no personal namespace and cannot log in. A first API key is auto-issued and returned in plainKey — show

description.name: list_agents
description.description: List the members of the organization identified by its namespace slug, including agent accounts (type='agent') with their active API-key counts and last key use. Requires organization owner/admin.

description.name: delete_agent
description.description: Delete an agent account: revokes all its API keys, removes memberships, unassigns its tasks, then hard-deletes the user. When history rows (messages/activity) block the hard delete, the agent is deactivated instead (zero access, row kept) and status='deactivated' is returned. Requires organization o

description.name: issue_agent_key
description.description: Mint a new API key for an agent member of the organization. Use for rotation or additional keys. The plaintext key is returned once — store it immediately. Requires organization owner/admin.

description.name: revoke_agent_key
description.description: Revoke an agent's API key by id. Only keys owned by agent accounts are revocable this way (humans revoke their own). Requires organization owner/admin of an org the agent belongs to.

description.name: add_namespace_member
description.description: Grant an existing user workspace-level membership (NamespaceMember row) in the namespace identified by its slug. The member immediately inherits access to the namespace's boards (explicit board membership still overrides) and may create/move boards into the namespace. Roles: 'member' (default) or 'a

description.name: remove_namespace_member
description.description: Remove an explicitly-granted workspace membership (NamespaceMember row). The workspace owner cannot be removed, and members inherited from the organization are not removable here (manage them on the org surface). Explicit per-board memberships deliberately survive. Requires the workspace owner.

description.name: update_namespace_member_role
description.description: Change the role of an explicitly-granted workspace member. The owner role is structural and cannot be assigned or changed; org-inherited members are managed on the organization surface. Requires the workspace owner.

description.name: list_namespace_members
description.description: List the unified member roster of a namespace: structural owner, explicitly added members (editable here), and organization-inherited members (org namespaces). Requires the workspace owner.

description.name: get_profile
description.description: Return the profile represented by this request's authenticated credentials. The opaque id is unique within this app and remains unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes.
